verdict.rationale: Bolt documents a first-party Visual edits feature that lets users change how the project looks directly in the preview, which matches the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single line and does not confirm element selection or which properties can be edited. Code view also allows token-free direct edits, but that is raw code editing rather than visual element editing. Missing for 10: documented element selection, explicit text/style/layout editing controls, confirmation that visual edits avoid a prompt round-trip, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip

citations.quote: Visual edits let you change how your project looks directly in the preview.
